notes: Wikidata "wrought iron": iron with very little carbon and fibrous slag inclusions, worked with hammers. Bloom iron is wrought iron made in a bloomery.
Wikidata "copper", the element. Our copper is the metal, whose properties Wikidata gives on the element.
Wikidata "diamond": allotrope of carbon used as a gemstone and an abrasive.
Wikidata "flint": sedimentary rock, a variety of chert.
Wikidata "limestone": sedimentary rock of calcium carbonate.
Wikidata "limonite": hydrated iron oxide mineral, the ore of bog iron.
Wikidata "native copper": the mineral, as opposed to the element.
Wikidata "steel": alloy of iron and other elements.
Wikidata "tin", the element. Our tin is the metal, whose properties Wikidata gives on the element.
Wikidata "bronze": alloy of copper and tin.
